description:
Ask the Basis Agent a question about attested risk state.

    Answers cite attestation hashes; ungroundable queries are refused. Never
    recommends positions or forecasts. Pass your hub API key (x-api-key header
    or ?apikey=) to attribute reads. Multi-turn: pass the envelope's
    session_id back as session_id.

    Parameters:
        query: The question (max 4000 chars).
        session_id: Session UUID from a previous envelope (optional).
name: basis_answer
